services.name: First home visit
services.story: The main story: Alex, who can't easily leave home, pays for a $349 first home visit with David, Thu Oct 22 at 8:00am, out of pocket. A card is saved for the $89 late-cancel fee, and the $349 is charged at DONE. The receipt has what Alex's plan needs to pay Alex back.

services.name: First home visit
services.story: The same first home visit when Alex's plan pays in network and bars late fees: nothing is taken, no card is saved, and the office bills the plan its own way.

services_shape: one patient with one clinician at a time, each visit a set length; a new patient starts with a free intro call, then a first visit; follow-up medicine visits are set as a repeat time the patient says yes to; a teen visit has a parent or guardian
questions_before_times: for you (18 or older), or for your teen (a parent or guardian books)
which state you'll be in during your visit
a health plan (its name only), or paying yourself
what you'd like in a clinician, in your own words: like a woman or a man, a language, Saturdays or evenings, the office, video or your home
for a home visit: the town, and the kind of place
safety_stop: harming someone else, or anyone in danger right now
first_steps: The plan's OK for visits ahead
license: the business's own word, optional: each prescriber (a psychiatrist, physician assistant or nurse practitioner) holds the state's license for the patients they see, video included; the practice may add a registration. Rosie never looks a license up and never says one is checked
staff_skills: who sees adults, teens and families; who offers video and home visits; who speaks which language; how each lists themselves (like a woman or a man) for patients who ask
messages_never: patient texts carry only the display name, the date, the time, the place and a secure link: never 'psychiatry', 'medicine', 'therapy', the kind of visit, a diagnosis, a medicine name or a child's details; at the office, never the clinician's name (it's on the secure page); at home, the clinician's name and photo stay, for the door check; the video link stays on the secure page
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
